title: Cyber Wolf Oracle
description: A black cybernetic wolf with glowing yellow eyes rests its head on a circuit-patterned throne, one paw touching its face. Behind it a towering female figure with a decorated skull-like face, purple flower crown, and flowing hair merges with a dramatic sunset sky, while a glowing futuristic highway with rocket-powered motorcyclists curves through the foreground.
prompt: A majestic black cyber wolf with glowing yellow eyes rests its head on an ornate mechanical throne, gently touching its face with one paw. Behind the wolf a giant ethereal female figure with a white skull-like face, closed eyes, purple flower crown and long flowing hair merges into a dramatic purple and orange sunset sky with a large glowing sun. A winding futuristic highway with glowing lines and several rocket-powered motorcyclists speeds through the dark foreground, iridescent bubbles floating in the air, intricate circuit patterns, dark fantasy meets cyberpunk aesthetic.
